function.arguments: {"index": 3, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The raw comparison of response rates by sex is confounded by baseline severity, which is systematically imbalanced between sexes in the treatment arm. Females are more likely to have mild severity (35 vs 23), which is strongly associated with higher response. Males are overrepresented in moderate and severe categories, which have lower response rates. To estimate the true sex effect, I computed adjusted response rates using stratification by severity, weighting each sex's response rate by the overall severity distribution in the treatment arm. This removes the confounding effect of severity and provides a fairer comparison."}
function.name: resolve_finding
